Data: [TidyTuesday 2026-07-07](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/tree/main/data/2026/2026-07-07).

Across 8,258 UFC fights from 1997 to 2026, how a fight ends tracks how heavy the fighters are, in both the men's and the women's divisions.
The knockout share climbs from under a quarter of men's flyweight bouts to more than half of all men's heavyweight bouts, and it rises the same way through the women's divisions, while the share that reaches the judges falls just as steadily.
Submissions barely move, holding near one fight in five across every division, so the heavier the fight, the less likely it is to leave the outcome to the scorecards.
